title: Result collector lands measurements/*.verdicts.json that research-results-guard R3 rejects: result PRs strand (#17085)
note: [2026-10-12 RESEARCH-OPS-1447] #17085 (automation/research-result-37729699069-1, unit RQ-20261007-004, run 37729699069, open since 2026-10-08, auto-merge armed) can never merge: it adds research/results/RQ-20261007-004/measurements/{ict_scalp_5m,ict_scalp_avax_5m,ict_scalp_eth_15m,ict_scalp_sol_15m,ict_scalp_sol_5m,ict_scalp_xrp_15m,ict_scalp_xrp_5m}.verdicts.json (865-1032 lines each, whole-file JSON) and guards fails research-results-guard R3 ('the store holds only .jsonl', check_research_results.py:88). Reproduced: merging origin/main into the branch and running python3 scripts/ci/check_research_results.py exits 1 with 7 R3 errors; on main the same guard is OK (files=517, problems=0). The result row ITSELF points at those files (artifact.store = research/results/RQ-20261007-004/measurements/<leg>.verdicts.json), so the producer (GEOM-B1 harness, #17011) and the guard contradict each other. FIX: either have the producer write the per-leg verdicts as .jsonl (one row per cell) or to a path outside research/results/ (e.g. comms/research/<unit>/) and point artifact.store there; then re-land the 7 legs' result (measured verdict no_action_warranted on all 7; xrp_15m: 2 cells cleared the gate without improving calibration = not a pass per RULE-RQ1007-004-SCALP-TARGET-REVISION). RERUN: git fetch origin automation/research-result-37729699069-1 && git worktree add /tmp/w FETCH_HEAD && (cd /tmp/w && git merge origin/main && python3 scripts/ci/check_research_results.py). Also check other open automation/research-result-* PRs for the same R3 signature.
